name: XT60 connector
summary: High-current battery connector. Needs a 16 x 8 mm slot.
source: The XT60 shell is 16.2 x 8.1 mm across the flats. The 16.4 x 8.3 mm opening here leaves the quarter millimetre a printed panel needs. Rated 60 A by name, though the wire and the solder joint decide the real figure.

keepouts.label: Room for the plug and cable

electrical.note: Named for 60 A. Treat that as a peak, not a continuous rating.
